experiment_system_world.World: Externally sample-and-hold category A probability states Sπ={0.2,0.35,0.5,0.65,0.8}; category mean/variance, true stimulus and experimenter category-feedback process. Run lengths actual 80–120 trials, no block-start cue. Experimental reward correctness feedback is explicit, not a participant's internal learned environment hazard.
experiment_system_world.participants: 11 human observers (including one author) in measurement then trained covert and overt tasks, 200 training plus 800 experimental trials per categorization session
experiment_system_world.task_instruments: Covert implicit keypress noisy orientation category; overt pre-stimulus explicitly set oriented criterion by mouse (continuous) with adjustment noise, not identical task-dependent observations.
experiment_system_world.System: Candidate internal category-probability estimator or posterior plus criterion readout. Each candidate original model is a competing possible SYSTEM and not a stack of simultaneously demonstrated internal submodules.
experiment_system_world.Experiment: Data 11 observers per task and model-likelihood / group protected exceedance comparison; plotted moving averages and sample/simulated CI are experimenter probe, not participant internal cognition.

native_variants.math: Original main Eq1 and exact S1 EqS1–S24; joint posterior over run length r and prior state ξ and Markov dependence on preceding category-prob state after changes; integrate state π to generate predicted category probabilities.
Original main named Bayes_r wrong expected run-length, Bayes_π wrong allowed category states, Bayes_β equal-prior Beta(β,β) hyperprior; source variants not one undifferentiated Bayes black box.

Original main Bayes_rπβ flexible five extra free parameters, separate BIC/ELBO fitting. NOT included usual main original Fig3/Table1 due to different fitting and model complexity; S1 separately plots/compares.
Main Eq3: p_hat1=0.5, p_hat_t+1=α C_t+(1-α)p_hat_t, fixed smoothing.
Main Eq3 then Eq4: tilde_p=w p_hat+(1-w)*0.5, criterion from this mix, source two distinct timescales interpretation not directly measured neuronal storage.

Main Eqs5–6 Wilson et al 2013 approximate hazard-weighted mixture of 3 delta-rule nodes, l1=1 l2 l3/νp free, h=0.01 source model parameter; predecessor publication plus source cites later original erratum.
Main Eq7 update the DECISION CRITERION z only after NEGATIVE feedback, does NOT estimate category probability as Exp does.
Publisher S1 p11 EqS25 separate optional RL updating probability on negative feedback, NOT the main RL Eq7; test does not conflate.
Main Eqs8–9 cited Behrens et al 2007 state posterior over π, volatility and volatility change, plus bias adaptation; distinct full grid not main Bayes run length.
Main Eq2 neutral fixed criterion comparator and one or more source appendix variants; not evidence humans never update.
